title: Declaration follows the crackdown
detail: After the Pakistan Army began its 25 March assault, an independence declaration was circulated in Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's name, recasting the crisis as a struggle for a separate sovereign state.

title: Provisional leadership adopts the proclamation
detail: The provisional leadership adopted the Proclamation of Independence, providing a formal constitutional basis for wartime authority and for the emerging state of Bangladesh.

title: Mujibnagar gives the proclamation institutional form
detail: The oath-taking of the Mujibnagar Government translated the proclamation into an operating wartime administration, linking declaratory sovereignty to organized executive leadership.

title: Founding legality enters state memory
detail: Later constitutional and public memory narratives treated the declaration and proclamation as core founding texts of Bangladesh's independence and wartime legitimacy.
